basic_info.description: Discover this delightful 1948 single-family home nestled in the desirable Sunset District of San Francisco. This residence seamlessly combines vintage character with thoughtful modern updates, It is the ideal starter home. Offering three well-appointed bedrooms and one and a half baths, this home is in immaculate turn-key condition. You'll be enchanted by the dining room's partial ocean view, adding a serene backdrop to your daily dining experiences. Inside, enjoy the fresh ambiance of newly painted walls and refinished hardwood floors that exude timeless elegance. The kitchen is equipped with a brand-new stove and dishwasher, perfect for culinary enthusiasts. Skylights fill the home with natural light, creating a bright and welcoming atmosphere. A spacious garage offers plenty of storage, complemented by a newly installed garage door for added convenience. Adding to the home's value is a one-year-old roof, ensuring long-lasting durability and peace of mind. Bus lines are steps away on Quintara. Walking distance to Safeway, Starbucks, Poplar restaurants, community park and much more... Easy access to Highway 1 and 280. Schedule a tour today and discover all the wonderful features this home has to offer!
